interventions.detail: Created a Python 3.10 uv venv; old pins (scikit-image 0.17.2, scikit-learn 0.24.2) cannot install on system Python 3.12
Relaxed pins to scikit-image 0.19.3, scikit-learn 1.3.2, numpy<2; skipped unused tensorflow
Installed torch 2.7.1+cu128 / torchvision 0.22.1 (torch not listed in requirements; cu128 needed for sm_120)
apt install libgl1 libglib2.0-0 for opencv-python (libGL.so.1 missing)
apt install unzip to extract big-lama.zip
Pass weights_only=False to torch.load in saicinpainting/training/trainers/__init__.py (PyTorch>=2.6 default rejects Lightning checkpoint)
